newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline flat to narrowly weaker after U.S.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline flat to narrowly weaker after U.S.

text.p: NWE gasoline was flat to narrowly weaker on Friday after U.S. gasoline futures ran out of steam on Thursday, wiping out some screen crude gains.
Public holidays across parts of Europe quietened trade.
Eurograde barges were pegged around $228 fob AR, off $1 or so form Friday, but nothing was heard traded.
Gasoline swaps were weaker by $1-2 with August essentially talked out. September was pegged around $202 with October valued about $192.
